Fixed an issue where Chastise was not usable in Shadowform. Warlock Destruction Fixed an issue where Intensity was not working on Incinerate. Warrior Fixed an issue where players could have and use Mortal Strike from their spellbook, even without the Mortal Strike talent. This does not remove it from their spellbook but prevents it from being used without the talent point spent. Dungeons Uldaman The Obsidian Sentinel drops loot as intended. Murloc Fin Soup has had its recovery and Well-Fed amounts increased to the next tier of food, bringing it closer to other food of that level. items.title: Lockboxes Hotfixed to Push Loot in WoW: Forever
items.summary: Lockboxes Hotfixed to Push Loot in WoW: Forever With a new hotfix pushed a few hours ago in WoW: Forever, players can no longer preview the loot contained inside lockboxes. Before this fix, rogues could use the loot key on an opened lockbox to preview its contents before returning it to the owner. Due to a bug, the preview showed different loot for the rogue and the owner, so players could keep re-checking boxes to fish for rare items and recipes. Lockbox exploit by u/intertiae in classicwow This change is similar to the one made to the retail world event boxes, which all got hotfixed to push loot on June 24, 2026. Previously, players could peek inside daily bags such as Satchel of Chilled Goods and Loot-Filled Pumpkin , then wait for another daily bag to "reroll" the contents and only loot the bag once it contained rare items. November 23 Update: Blizzard Working on a Proper Lockbox Fix Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Confirming that the change to lockbox behavior was made yesterday at 18:55 CET as a temporary measure. Today, we’re working on a proper fix that restores the ability to peek and partially loot lockboxes, and makes them otherwise work as intended. We don’t yet know how long the fix will take, but we’ll post about it when it’s done.

items.title: New Streamer Mode and Name Masking Options Datamined
items.summary: New Streamer Mode and Name Masking Options Datamined We have datamined new streamer mode and name masking CVars in Build 71087 of the 12.1.7 PTR. These options are also mentioned in the Forever interface files, so they will likely arrive in both Retail and Forever. Originally Posted by MMO-Champion streamerMode - Whether the name replacement logic across the UI is in effect streamerModeDockedChat - Whether the streamer mode features affect docked chat windows streamerNameMasking - Whether names of other players are masked for the user battleTagNameMasking - Whether the BattleTags of other players are replaced with asterisks playerBattleTagNameMasking - Whether the player's own BattleTag is replaced with asterisks groupMessageMasking - Whether the messages of other players in party and raid chat are replaced with asterisks realIDNameMasking - Whether the Real IDs of other players are replaced with asterisks streamerNameMasking - Whether names of other players are masked for the user whisperMessageMasking - Whether the messages of other players in whispers are replaced with asterisks Please note that this is a work in progress and mostly unimplemented in the current PTR build.
